incidents.name: unverified_0x00C409 unvalidated swap target
incidents.notes: Selector 0xba381f8f on the unverified arbitrage bot took caller-supplied pool and token addresses and executed the swap against them without any access control or whitelist, so a fake pool returning fabricated getReserves()/calcOutGivenIn() values let the caller withdraw the bot's ether.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0x00C409001C1900DdCdA20000008E112417DB003b created 2020-11-27T01:14:04Z by 0xa4f6648b6bdfaf3a0f2f4581abf7866108bce5d4, not the attack-tx sender 0x6beff34a8864b6d44d49ba300c551a81011d6b19; unverified, no DELEGATECALL upgrade path and no EIP-1967 events, so age is measured from deployment (1237 days). ~18 WETH at an April 2024 ETH price near $3,100 is far above the $1,000 floor. Loss converted at the incident timestamp: 18 WETH x $3,041.14 (DefiLlama historical ETH price) = $54,740.
